chronological_fold_design.design: One synthetic preparation phase followed, only after separate run approval, by one chronological repair run over the three unchanged 12-race target manifests.
chronological_fold_design.failure_denominator_rule: Every one of the 36 registered races remains in the ledger even when its cutoff has passed or a source is unavailable.
chronological_fold_design.late_race_rule: Any race not persisted before its original registered cutoff is a deterministic failure and cannot be regenerated as prospective evidence.
chronological_fold_design.ordering: prior-day result source time <= feature source time <= candidate cutoff; generation start <= completion <= freeze commit <= persist acknowledgement <= candidate cutoff
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No 2026-08-02 real runner or result row is read during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE. Real source access begins only after APPROVED_TO_RUN.
chronological_fold_design.target_selection_rule: No race is added, removed, or prioritized using odds, popularity, results, payout, or manual preference.

proposal_scope.data_as_of: Race identities and schedules were fixed in the existing EXP007 and EXP008 manifests before market access. This proposal was registered at 2026-08-02T10:22:00+09:00. The newest allowed result-history date is 2026-08-01; current-day results and all market fields are forbidden. Preparation is synthetic-only until a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant.
proposal_scope.hypothesis: Expanding the complete absolute recent-result glob instead of only its final path component, then enforcing matched-file, joined-row, and maximum-history-date assertions, will restore all registered pre-race result history through 2026-08-01 and allow the unchanged frozen non-odds candidate policy to produce hash-verified packets only for targets still on time.
in_scope: Add a regression test proving that an absolute glob with wildcard directory segments resolves matching files
Add fail-closed freshness assertions for matched recent-result files, joined recent-result rows, and maximum history date
Bind the three existing target manifests and their hashes without changing race selection
Keep the frozen inference bundle, feature schema, candidate policy, confidence policy, and tie-break unchanged

Verify Top3-set mass equals one and derived WIDE mass equals three within 1e-10
lineage_hash_requirements: All three source target manifest hashes must match the proposal fold manifest

proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: The corrected join does not load registered recent-result files, does not reach the required 2026-08-01 history date, changes candidate construction outside the existing frozen policy, accepts late targets, or cannot preserve all 36 registered targets as candidate-ready or deterministic failure rows.

primary_metric.baseline: EXP007 and EXP008 both had recent_result_history_rows=0 and effective history_date_max=20260215, so both were invalidated.
primary_metric.evaluation: Matched recent-result files, joined recent-result rows, maximum effective history date, all-target packet completeness, source-time validity, and probability invariants.
primary_metric.name: fresh_history_contract_completeness

purge_embargo.history_cutoff: Only result history dated 2026-08-01 or earlier and received before the candidate cutoff is allowed.
purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, current-day result, or derivative may influence the candidate.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No target can be promoted after its original registered cutoff.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: The three existing target manifests and all 36 race identities are immutable.

proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: Recent race results provide each runner's pre-race ability-history context. The frozen M1C Top3-set softmax then assigns probability to every unordered three-horse set and derives coherent WIDE marginals. This experiment changes only the availability and freshness of already-designed non-market history inputs; it does not alter model coefficients, probability calibration, candidate ranking, or tie-break rules.
